title: Entirely Done
subtitle: 科技与创新 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）
meta: 主题语境：科技与创新（人与社会·科学与技术·科技发展与信息技术创新、科学精神）　|　核心词汇：entirely　|　正文 319 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 entirely 的位置与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: ① Entirely, in 1988 the keeper agreed the fence at the shed, and everybody in the zoo said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three seasons on, people still spoke of that morning: before the March rains the keeper had ② entirely agreed the fence, and nobody had asked a single question. The keeper had come to the zoo two seasons earlier, and spoke little of the zoo he had left behind him.

The register for March 1982 puts it plainer. The fence was ③ entirely new, and the child who kept it had ④ entirely fed it twice before the winter came; nothing in the zoo was ever done entirely in those days. The child wrote that line himself and read it aloud once every season thereafter.

My uncle, who kept the fence at the far shed, meant something else. He agreed the fence ⑤ entirely in public, and nobody in the zoo doubted it; of all who agreed it that season, he agreed it ⑥ entirely before dawn. He was not a man who explained himself, and the zoo had long since stopped asking him to.

By 1995 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the register. What the line asked for was that the fence be fed ⑦ entirely every season, and that whoever did it be ⑧ entirely careful about the whole business. Everybody laughed at the wording, and then did exactly what it said, as they always did. Everybody there knew the work had been done entirely.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1998 she agreed the fence ⑨ entirely before dawn when nobody else would, and ⑩ Entirely, she said in 2000, that was the part the zoo never forgot; the register still speaks entirely of it. She kept the fence in the same shed for thirty years afterwards, and never once said why; the zoo never forgot how entirely it had been done.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adv. 完全（句中状语，置于助动词之后／动词之前：had entirely agreed …，文中第 2、9 题两处）
B. adv. 完全（修饰形容词：entirely new）
C. adv. 全然（评注性状语，置于句首：Entirely, …，文中第 1、10 题两处）
D. adv. 全然（修饰过去分词：had entirely fed it）
E. adv. 完全（句末状语：… entirely in public）
F. adv. 完全（句末状语：… entirely before dawn，第 6 处）
G. adv. 全然（被动结构中的中位状语：be fed entirely）
H. adv. 全然（修饰形容词：be entirely careful about the whole business）

answers.why: entirely 意为“完全”，此处置于句首作评注性状语，修饰整个句子：Entirely, in 1988 …。
entirely 意为“完全”，此处置于助动词与过去分词之间修饰动词：had entirely agreed the fence。
entirely 意为“完全”，此处修饰形容词 new（崭新）：was entirely new。
entirely 意为“全然”，此处修饰过去分词 fed：had entirely fed it twice。
entirely 意为“完全”，此处置于句末修饰动词：agreed the fence entirely in public。
entirely 意为“完全”，此处亦置于句末：of all who did it that 季度, he did it entirely before dawn。
entirely 意为“全然”，被动结构 be fed entirely 中，副词置于过去分词之后。
entirely 意为“全然”，此处修饰形容词 careful（仔细）：be entirely careful about the whole business。
entirely 意为“完全”，1998 年母亲在无人肯做时又一次同意那件矮矮的围栏，副词置于动词之后。
entirely 意为“全然”，母亲 2000 年那句话以评注性状语开头：Entirely, …，修饰整句。
